# JEA REMINDER: Code of Conduct

**Published: 14th June 2022**

The Jersey Electoral Authority (JEA) wishes to remind candidates that, as part of the nomination process, they all agreed to adhere to the Code of Conduct during the election.   The JEA urges all candidates to ensure that they are familiar with the contents of the Code and to remain within the terms and spirit of the Code throughout their campaigning.
